<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary debate:</strong> Following a week-long deadlock, the Lok Sabha commenced a six-hour debate on the anti-paper leak Bill, while both houses faced repeated adjournments due to ongoing opposition protests regarding the NEET examination issue.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxQcjdFVndmT0ZrUEhEM2xTdUpOVVlsNlBDLXluVjJEMGFYM2hBM2d6QnFoaXJzR0JzVVRaeUlMYmVNWmZhanhFdnIyc3ZSeTZlVXVhLVllUEFzc0dCYmxsaWpVYjhsdTByLWU2Y3ZEN3BJbjNJTVVfVFM0V1IwWWdvbEg1ZTNUSlZqVk1zU2ZNR2VqbEVQVFdNa0xJY1N3cEFHdXBtYUloZUZNZUVtYXYwWmVZR3JXMUlseUljVnVTa25BbTBfOGc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political friction:</strong> Opposition leaders, including Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi, criticized the BJP for the celebratory welcome given to Minister Dharmendra Pradhan in Parliament, accusing the government of ignoring the futures of students.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I31</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I32</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial directives:</strong> The Delhi High Court ruled that while the Election Commission can deploy teachers for election duties, it must ensure such assignments do not impose &quot;unbearable&quot; stress or violate the Right to Education mandate.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Digital regulation:</strong> The Supreme Court has urged the Centre to establish a standalone law to criminalize &quot;digital arrest&quot; scams and regulate deepfakes, while a parliamentary panel summoned major social media platforms to discuss stricter digital regulation.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxPSjNfc3EyTklIYUZpOVhUV2pDV3dxX0pSVzVXdzlkRlB0emhmQ19KcDZKVVVma0lvVmlUcHJncTJ4dnQtQm84U2VVdGJuWTlYVkVuM0tZZEhmZlY2VVdxMnVFSlJsc2RfcXdjbzUzQmhGU29YMnA3OHpmSWxZQWs3VTgzQ1FLWHpzZ012MkNwcnFVZWpYUlY4RWlrdXZPYWhKV0dVenBVd0E5cmNGNGNSdEVpc2Rvb3ZYSHRYZlFPV1NfdVo4QlNv?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>NDA expansion:</strong> The NCPI participated in its first NDA parliamentary party meeting, joining the coalition as the government prepares to push its legislative agenda, including the Public Examinations Amendment Bill.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQM3pyQXVhdXYtUkV0TVZDLTRvQ0V2Y09XdDNQVURBTnRabGtJWW92NGl6M3lqWlAwaXdBdURPWU5VNkRPSGlNZlZ2Z3FsdXZsdXJ5dVZ4d0pZRUxCNW05alpfVnFvaVVBWk9Ra0lBNUg1NFNvT0c3SHFaeUtWSkFwVlMxYUxlZ2gyMVMxQlBBR0xrSjlxWENUcndiaUlmY3I0WUE5RF9JaE5YQXBrRWd6XzRrdw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a></span></li>
</ul>
